selected_user_text: In a study, 12 randomized controlled trials were pooled for the outcomes of 24-hour postoperative nausea. The relative risk (RR) for nausea after acustimulation was found to be 0.59 with a 95% confidence interval (CI) of 0.46-0.76. If in a control group 80 out of 160 children experienced nausea, how many children would be expected to experience nausea after acustimulation based on the RR provided?
